data.name: DISPATCHED
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to Terminal 07.

You are Operator #15 at Pinefall Emergency Dispatch — night shift. Your job is simple: answer 911 calls, identify the emergency, and dispatch the right unit. Police, fire, medical — each with their own strengths and response times.

But Pinefall isn't a normal town.

The static on your radio is getting louder. Your units aren't always coming back. And some of those calls don't sound human. Make mistakes and the static rises faster. Let it consume you, and your shift is over — permanently.

FEATURES

- Answer procedurally generated emergency calls and dispatch the correct response unit

- Manage police, fire, and medical units with different strengths and response times

- Monitor the rising static — every mistake accelerates the horror

- Roguelike progression: each shift gets harder with new threats emerging

- Upgrade your terminal between shifts to survive longer

- Full CRT terminal aesthetic with glitch effects and atmospheric audio design

- Dynamic weather system affecting response times

- Multiple game-over scenarios and S-to-F operator grading

- Mid-shift save system

BEST EXPERIENCED

With headphones. In the dark. Alone. Keyboard only — you're an operator, act like one.

"The static does not forget. It never forgets."
